question: Which native hook relay observability shape should remain for the Codex relay fan-out investigation: this per-invocation/per-handler timing PR, PR #102241's aggregate relay metrics, or a combined narrowed version?
rationale: Two open external PRs instrument the same investigation, and choosing per-handler timing versus aggregate relay counters is an operations/product judgment rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Prefer Aggregate Relay Metrics
options.body: After proof, keep PR #102241 as the relay observability lane and split only the plugin-handler timing from this PR if maintainers still want it.

options.title: Prefer This Timing PR
options.body: Ask for redacted real-run proof here, then land this per-invocation and per-handler timing shape and close or narrow PR #102241.

options.title: Pause Both Until Mitigation Direction
options.body: Keep both instrumentation PRs paused until maintainers choose the canonical relay fan-out mitigation for issue #91009.

recommendation.title: Prefer Aggregate Relay Metrics
recommendation.body: After proof, keep PR #102241 as the relay observability lane and split only the plugin-handler timing from this PR if maintainers still want it.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has recent relay timeout work and plugin hook-runner history across both touched surfaces, making him the strongest available routing candidate for the observability-shape choice.
